Verify via logs or bus trace that retry intervals are 100 ms for DCSD version requests and 17 ms for touch data requests.
Verify via configuration review and I2C bus trace that the Radio operates as I2C Master and DCSD operates as I2C Slave (Case 2).
Verify via GPIO trace that GPIO-0 is high in idle state and transitions low on DCSD interrupt.
Verify via GPIO and I2C trace that GPIO-0 returns high after touch data is read or after 100 ms with no Radio response.
Verify via touch drag test that duplicate touch events with identical coordinates are continuously reported and not filtered.
Verify via timing measurement that touch transmit interval is ≥15 ms and end-to-end Radio latency is ≤16.6 ms.
